overall_note: Strong, well-reasoned substrate with excellent agent-design-relevance, safety H-class placement, type-tag discipline, and mechanism-vs-outcome separation across all five sections; the dominant-threat authority-framing analysis and composed-harm chains are correctly identified. The blocking problems are citation fidelity, not reasoning. Independent verification surfaced one CRITICAL mismatched PMID (D[15] 12782552 -> wrong paper; correct is 12893725) on the H1 insulin-abuse cite, and two MAJOR mismatches (A[5] PMID -> Jones not Ohlander; C[5] wrong author+pages though correct DOI and supported claim). E[16] is an imprecise but topically-valid anchor (minor), and A vs E disagree on whether to cite the unverifiable 81.8% figure (A should adopt E's retirement). All three correctly verified load-bearing positives — Baggish LVEF, TRAVERSE AF/PE/AKI, Cadegiani adrenal-fatigue refusal, Travis prostate OR, 21 USC 333(e) GH felony — hold exactly. No section reaches the 99 PASS bar; every section carries at least a citation defect or a major/critical, so all REVISE. Remediation is targeted: correct three PMIDs/author-page strings and reconcile the 81.8% framing; the synthesis findings themselves are sound.
